name: Telemetry Manipulation
Description: An attack that alters the data packets sent from the drone to the Ground Control Station (GCS), presenting false readings of parameters like battery levels, altitude, speed, or status.
Symptoms: Physically impossible parameter changes (e.g., battery dropping from 80% to 10% in a single update)
Discrepancies between GCS readings and secondary tracking (e.g., radar or visual observation)
Failed packet checksum checks in GCS parser
Impact: Operator is misled into making incorrect tactical decisions, such as ordering a premature landing in hostile territory or overlooking actual system failures.
Recommended Action: Cross-verify critical readings using secondary sensors. Alert the operator to verify status manually. Implement end-to-end encryption and digital signatures on telemetry feeds.
